open_questions: Product name differs between documents: bulletins DL2-11412.PDF p.1-2 and DL2-14639.pdf p.1-2 print 'HiTEC® 12200' / 'HiTEC® 12200 HDEO Additive Package'; SDS DL2-12074.pdf p.1 prints 'HiTEC® 12200 Performance Additive' (SDS no. H12200).
Supplier: bulletins (DL2-14639.pdf p.2) name Afton Chemical Corporation; SDS DL2-12074.pdf p.1 lists Afton Chemical Asia Pte. Ltd. and other Afton entities under 'Manufacturer / Supplier'.

revision_date: bulletins print only '05/18' (DL2-11412.PDF p.2) and '08/18' (DL2-14639.pdf p.2) in the copyright line; SDS DL2-12074.pdf p.1 'Date of issue/Date of revision: 7/16/2019'. product.revision_date is a list in source_file order.

Claim type: every matrix column sits under the printed header 'Approvals' (DL2-14639.pdf p.2), including API categories, so claim_type = 'approval'. Columns MB 228.1, MB 229.1 and MAN 3275 carry footnote 5 'Meets requirements of (MRO)' and are set to 'meets'. Please confirm this reading.
Treat rates and booster doses are printed as '%' with no mass/volume basis (DL2-14639.pdf p.2); only footnote 3 says '% wt'. Unit kept as '%'.

Rows and columns only in the 08/18 bulletin (DL2-14639.pdf p.2), absent from 05/18 (DL2-11412.PDF p.2): row '10.8% + 0.9% HiTEC® 12260, SAE 10W-30, GP II' (API CI-4, API SL); row '10.8% + 0.6% HiTEC® 9552, SAE 10W-40, GP II/III' (API SN, API SL, API SJ, ACEA A3/B4-16, MB 229.3, RN 0700); columns API SN, MB 229.3, RN 0700. Not treated as conflicts (additions, not disagreements).

Footnote 6 differs: 05/18 (DL2-11412.PDF p.2) '6 Formulations, available in Q2 2018' on the two SAE 10W-40 rows; 08/18 (DL2-14639.pdf p.2) '6 11.15% HiTEC® 12252 = 10.8% HiTEC® 12200 + 0.35% HiTEC® 9552' on the 10.8% SAE 15W-40 GP I row.

No complete published formulation (all ingredients summing to 100 wt.%) is printed; published_formulations left Missing. The bar charts on DL2-14639.pdf p.2 (Mack T-12, Cat 1K, Seq IIIF, T8E vs 'API CI-4 Limit'/'Reserve') have no numeric values and were not recorded.
Old Product_JSON has no claims, route matrix or co-components for this product although both bulletins print them; the new file fills them from DL2-14639.pdf p.2.
